verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents issuing cards, including virtual ones, and offers a separate Stage environment. However, nothing shows that card details (PAN, CVV, expiry) can be retrieved programmatically at issuance. The path to live is gated: Pomelo prepares the test environment, and an 11-day kickoff-to-first-transaction record shows a managed integration process rather than self-serve. Missing for 10: explicit one-call card-creation API documentation, programmatic access to PAN/CVV/expiry at issuance, and self-serve sandbox-to-production without a sales or integration cycle.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a virtual card through the API in one call — PAN, CVV, and expiry available programmatically the moment it's issued — and go from sandbox to a live card without a sales cycle
